```{r}
combined_augmented_median_data = read.csv("dab18_combined_augment_outlier_removed_median_subtracted.csv")
combined_augmented_median_data = combined_augmented_median_data %>% select(-cAb13) %>% mutate(across(target_vector, as.factor))

combined_augmented_mean_data = read.csv("dab18_combined_augment_outlier_removed_median_subtracted.csv")
combined_augmented_mean_data = combined_augmented_mean_data %>% select(-cAb13) %>% mutate(across(target_vector, as.factor))

og_combined_augmented_data = read.csv("combined_augmented_data.csv")

kh_clinical_data = read.csv('kh_clinical_processed.csv')
# For ease of use just changing sample ID to concentration
kh_clinical_data = kh_clinical_data %>% rename(Conc. = SampleID)
```

```{r}
# What I need is a ratio
# First we can try the ratio from the original paper
# To avoid division errors I'm just going to add 1 to all values, we can decide later if this is problematic lol but I dont think it is
ratio_df = combined_augmented_mean_data %>% filter(Conc. > 0.01)
ratio_df_ids = ratio_df %>% select(c(target_vector, Conc., Replicate))
ratio_df_fluorescence = ratio_df %>% select(starts_with("cAb"))
ratio_df_fluorescence = data.frame(lapply(ratio_df_fluorescence, function(x) {return (x+1)}))

ratio_df_p1 = bind_cols(ratio_df_ids, ratio_df_fluorescence)

ratio_df_p1 = ratio_df_p1 %>% 
  mutate(abs25.26 = cAb25/cAb26,
         abs26.25 = cAb26/cAb25,
         abs25.20 = cAb25/cAb20,
         abs20.25 = cAb20/cAb25,
         abs25.7 = cAb25/cAb7,
         abs7.25 = cAb7/cAb25,
         abs9.20 = cAb9/cAb20,
         abs20.9 = cAb20/cAb9,
         abs9.21 = cAb9/cAb21,
         abs10.21 = cAb10/cAb21,
         abs21.10 = cAb21/cAb10,
         abs15.10 = cAb15/cAb10,
         abs10.15 = cAb10/cAb15,
         abs82 = cAb8^2,
         abs152 = cAb15^2,
         abs102 = cAb10^2)

ratio_df_p1 %>% select(-starts_with("cAb")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(target_vector, Conc., Replicate),
               names_to = 'antibody_ratio',
               values_to = 'ratio_value') %>% 
  mutate(across(antibody_ratio, as.factor)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=target_vector, y=ratio_value))+
  geom_beeswarm(aes(color = Conc.))+
  facet_wrap(facets = 'antibody_ratio',
             scales = 'free')

ratio_df_p1 %>% select(-starts_with("cAb")) %>% 
  filter(Conc. > 1) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(target_vector, Conc., Replicate),
               names_to = 'antibody_ratio',
               values_to = 'ratio_value') %>% 
  mutate(across(antibody_ratio, as.factor)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=target_vector, y=ratio_value))+
  geom_beeswarm(aes(color = Conc.))+
  facet_wrap(facets = 'antibody_ratio',
             scales = 'free')

ratio_df_p1 %>% select(-starts_with("cAb")) %>% 
  filter(Conc. > 10) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(target_vector, Conc., Replicate),
               names_to = 'antibody_ratio',
               values_to = 'ratio_value') %>% 
  mutate(across(antibody_ratio, as.factor)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=target_vector, y=ratio_value))+
  geom_beeswarm(aes(color = Conc.))+
  facet_wrap(facets = 'antibody_ratio',
             scales = 'free')
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
combined_augmented_data
umap_viz = function(dataset,
                    plot_title = 'umap_plot'){
  # umap_param_grid = grid_latin_hypercube(
  #   n_neighbors = 
  #   min_dist = 
  #   n_components = 
  #   metric = 
  # )
  # 
  # umap_subplots = list()
  dataset = dataset %>% select(-c(Replicate)) %>% mutate(across(Conc., round, 3))
  
  umap_rec = recipe( ~ ., data = dataset) %>% 
    update_role(Conc., target_vector, new_role = "id") %>% 
    step_zv() %>% 
    step_normalize(all_predictors()) %>% 
    step_umap(all_predictors(), 
              num_comp = 2,
              neighbors = 15,
              min_dist = 0.1) %>% 
    prep()
  
  umap_embedding = juice(umap_rec)
  
  umap_embedding_plot = umap_embedding %>% 
    ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, label = Conc.)) + 
    geom_point(aes(color = target_vector), alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    geom_text(check_overlap = T, hjust = "inward", family = "IBMPlexSans") +
    labs(color = NULL,
         title = plot_title)
  
  print(umap_embedding_plot)
  
}
```
```{r}
umap_viz(og_combined_augmented_data, plot_title = "UMAP Projection of Original Data, No threshold")
umap_viz(combined_augmented_median_data, plot_title = "UMAP Projection of OR, median-subtracted Data, No threshold")
```
